summary: Coal-breaker labourer of Pennsylvania, born about 1900; John's great-granduncle.
bio: Frank Petrillo was born in Pennsylvania about 1900; one source gives July 1895, but his ages in the 1910 and 1920 censuses point to 1899 or 1900. By 1920, aged 20, he was working as a labourer at a coal breaker. He had died by November 1995, when his sister Josephine was survived by her brothers Nick, Jim and Rocco but not by Frank. He is John's great-granduncle.

researchLog.note: Imported from the project handoff (research rounds 1–3, Oct 2026).
Resolved: Birth 1895 (Geni) vs c.1900 (census) → Both censuses (10 in Apr 1910; 20 in Jan 1920) point to c.1899-1900. Geni's 'Frank W., b. Jul 1895' is unsupported.
Round 4: censuses fix birth c.1899-1900; not a survivor in 1995.
About text rewritten as narrative; the earlier research-note text is kept under Evidence notes.

researchNotes:
Frank, 10 in 1910 (b. c.1900 PA); laborer at a coal breaker in 1920. Geni lists Frank W. b. Jul 1895 PA, which Round 1 used to date the family's arrival; census age suggests c.1900.

Frank is 10 in the April 1910 census and 20 in January 1920, both consistent with birth c.1899–1900, not 1895 ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]). He is not among the brothers (Nick, Jim, Rocco) who survived his sister Josephine in November 1995, so he had died by then ([R4-S3]). No later record was found.
